service.description: The in-parameters the Sales context services share; each service declares what it returns.

Check that the user may open Sales and resolve their scope and the routes of the root that mounts Sales' screens: capabilities (each SALES_* permission, the derived reads anyRead, teamRead and reportRead, an edit permission alone reading nothing, the areas: reports, and reportCosts, whether the sales reports answer the user's costs: report read or PRODUCT_COST_VIEW), the organizations of their sales scope (none for a user who reads nothing of Sales; every internal organization for a system administrator, allOrganizations) as options, the active one, the user's party and the links (sharedLinks under the mounting root). Refuses a user without Sales (SALES_UNAVAILABLE), a Projects client contact and a PASS public account among them, and a root that mounts no Sales screen (SALES_CONTEXT).

parameter.name: organizationOptions
parameter.description: The organizations as {value, label}, by name, at most 100

service.description: A record a Sales screen or mount was given: an organization, an account and a contact (P3), an opportunity or lead (P4) (Sales.js recordKinds; later phases add the quote, order, agreement and forecast). Answers its kind's name, its organization in the user's scope, a label and a short detail. Refuses a record that does not exist and one outside the scope alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): an organization outside the user's, and any record for a user who reads nothing of Sales. With a capability named (reportRead, opportunityEdit, ...), refuses a user without it (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses a user without Sales (SALES_UNAVAILABLE).

The options of a Sales drop-down the user may choose, searched by term in the query ignoring case, with the selected value's label (Sales.js choiceSources): organizations (those of the user's sales scope); P2: teams (an organization's current sales teams) and teamMembers (the people who work for it, labelled with their job title for a reader of People's directory); P4: pipelines and stages (an organization's), owners (its people), sources (offered to it), lostReasons, recurringPlans, competitors (organizations of the scope) and dealContacts (an account's contacts). Later phases add theirs. None for a user who reads nothing of Sales. Refuses a user without Sales and an unknown choice.

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: P2: the organization a team or team member is chosen for

parameter.name: salesPipelineId
parameter.description: P4: the pipeline whose stages are chosen

parameter.name: accountPartyId
parameter.description: P4: the account whose contacts a deal's contact is chosen from

service.description: WorkItemDetail's Sales context (P4; crosscut §3.12 Sales row): a task linked to deals the user sees (SalesOpportunityWorkEffort; available), with those deals and their links. A task of no such deal is not available there. Refuses a user without Sales (SALES_UNAVAILABLE).

The palette's Sales records, each opening its Sales screen, with recordEntity and recordId for Assist's search (Sales.js searchFinds). None yet: accounts join with their screens (P3), opportunities and leads (P4), quotes and orders (P7, P11), agreements (P15). No rows for a user without Sales.
